decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until a drainage plan/s showing surface and foul water connections and their outfall details from the proposed development,&nbsp;including the incorporation of sustainable drainage features as appropriate, has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. </p><p>The works shall thereafter be retained in accordance with those approved details.</p>

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:

1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:

a) for fire appliances to be positioned on

b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point

2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures

3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread

4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users

5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in

6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.

The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until a schedule of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until a scheme for:-

(a) The storage and disposal of refuse/waste

(b) and vehicular access thereto;

has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall not be occupied or used until the works have been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved details.

<p>The development shall not be occupied until a scheme for cycle parking/storage for the proposed uses has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</p><p>The cycle parking/storage provision shall be in carried out in accordance with those approved details.</p>

<p>In the absence of a full justification or supporting evidence, the residential element of the development, by virtue of the site background noise, disturbance, poor outlook and security concerns associated with its location within a backland parking and servicing area alongside issues integral to the scheme’s design, would result in a substandard form of accommodation for future occupiers of the site to the detriment of their living conditions. The development is thereby contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3, D11, D13, and D14 of The London Plan (2021), Policies DM1 and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Documents Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp;</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Notwithstanding the approved scheme’s specific details, prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, the applicant shall obtain a Secured by Design Certification to demonstrate how they intend to minimise the risk of crime in a visually acceptable manner, or supply sufficient justification where the accreditation requirements cannot be met, which are to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These Secured by Design measures shall be implemented prior to occupation, and the development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details thereafter wherever practical.

The flat roof areas of the development hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area, unless expressly stated on the approved plans or unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until an allocation scheme for the proposed parking between uses has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with those approved details.
description: Demolition and redevelopment of office (Class E) to provide two storey mixed use building comprising ground floor office (Class E) and first floor self contained flat (1 X 1 bed) (Class C3); hard landscaping; parking; bin and cycle stores
